metadata.title: ADIVASI DAILY | कुड़मी जाति का प्रदर्शन | UP गोंड जनजाति ST | Komaram Bheem
metadata.description: Adivasi Daily is a news bulletin programme of Main Bhi Bharat. We cover news related to tribal India. In Todays Episode watch the story of komaram bheem and the impact of BJP win in tribal belts of Gujarat during assembly election. kurmi protest in delhi and increasing cases of TB in Tribal India.
